messages:
maya: Alert — billing spike in us-west1. Noticed weird scaling pattern: MIG created extra replicas in us-west1 despite pool config.
raj: Confirming. Autoscaler logs show fallback to region us-west1 at 02:07 UTC. MIG name: gpu-prod-mig. Wanted only us-west2 (we have commitments there).
zach: I pushed a terraform tweak earlier to make zone a variable. I thought defaults would be harmless but if the variable isn't set, module falls back to project default_region which is us-west1. Oops.
olivia: Can someone paste the terraform diff? I asked cloud support to freeze new instances. CASE-99821 opened.
infra-bot: TF plan applied: modules/gpu_pool: computed zone set to "${var.zone != "" ? var.zone : google_project.default_region}". Recent apply by @zach at 02:05 UTC.
billing-bot: Billing alert: project=infra-prod, +$36,700 in last 90m. Top: p4d-24x *12 (us-west1). Also high egress due to cross-region snapshot copy.
raj: Mitigation steps: 1) set MIG max replicas back to 60; 2) cordon & drain nodes not in us-west2; 3) delete newly created instance template pointing to us-west1.
Commands run:
```
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-autoscaling gpu-prod-mig --max-num-replicas=60 --zone=us-west2-a
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o wide | grep us-west1
kubectl cordon gpu-node-98
kubectl drain gpu-node-98 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
gcloud compute instance-templates delete gpu-template-us-west1-2026-03-02 --quiet
```
maya: I've capped the autoscaler and cordoned 8 nodes. Drains moving.
zach: I'm reverting terraform to make zone required (no default) and will add a CI check that plan changes include zone tag if module used. PR infra/terraform#411
olivia: Support responded: they can request re-allocation of committed capacity credits, but it's manual and not guaranteed. They've asked for timeline of error and counts. I've attached CASE-99821.
finance-bot: Finance brief: creating reconciliation ticket FIN-1180. Ask cloud partner about committed use discounts applicability across regional mismatch.
maya: Notes for postmortem: root cause appears to be a defaulting behavior in terraform module combined with a non-required variable. Suggested fixes: make zone mandatory, add pre-deploy lint to catch empty zone, tag instance templates with "billing:commitment-us-west2".
raj: Also propose runtime guard in autoscaler: refuse to scale outside preferred regions unless override flag explicit and timebox the override.
zach: Adding an alert: if >10% of new GPU instances created outside preferred_region within 30m, page infra-oncall.
olivia: Postmortem owners: maya (lead), zach (infra change), raj (autoscaler guard), olivia (billing interactions). Drafting postmortem: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-terraform-zone-leak
maya: Good work. Please paste exact TF diff and command outputs into the postmortem so finance can validate counts. :thumbsup:
